name: HIGH-VIX armed contrarian long — realized-vol spike exhaustion (BTC/ETH)
rationale: Thesis: a crypto realized-vol spike (vol_realized gt vol_spike) that coincides with elevated equity VIX (gt vix_floor) marks forced de-leveraging exhaustion — when BOTH the crypto tape and the equity-vol market are blown out together, the marginal seller is nearly done, and a bounce follows. Cross-asset confluence (two independent vol measures) is the selectivity. Both BOUNDED level gates. Exit when realized vol calms below vol_exit or risk/time stops. Disconfirmer 1 (is the equity-VIX arm load-bearing?): the same crypto-realized-vol-spike long with NO equity-VIX gate is in the cohort — if it matches the deflated Sharpe, the cross-asset arm adds nothing and this is just a vol-spike fade. Disconfirmer 2 (direction): vol-spike longs can be a knife-catch; if the holdout edge is negative the thesis FAILs honestly. Disconfirmer 3 (holdout): purged+embargoed recent slice must hold.
catalyst: crypto realized-vol spike AND equity VIX elevated together
